answer: CipherLantern resists sybils by locking a time-delayed collateral bond to each new identity and sealing one unrepeatable work sample hash into the admission ticket. The bond cannot underwrite a second identity until a review window closes and independent graders confirm the sample is original. A copied sample collides on-ledger and the shared bond is slashed, so mass-minted aliases burn capital without buying influence. We file that sample under a violet wax seal, state the method as a brief sonnet of procedure, and hang the ticket from a willow of prior peer attestations, not a reusable name.
